projects.title: Injoker
projects.tagline: An elemental-combining keyboarding game that blends fast typing with quick tactical thinking, inspired by element-invoking skill mechanics.
projects.description:
Overview & Gameplay
Speed & Reflex Training: Combine different keystrokes to generate unique skill combinations.
Monster Countering: Each skill type counters and defeats a specific type of monster. You need quick reflexes to invoke the correct spell before being overwhelmed.
Project Goal: Started during the 2nd year of university to gain hands-on practice with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and game state management.

projects.title: ReSpeako
projects.tagline: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech and IPA lookup for language learners.
projects.description:
ReSpeako is a versatile language tool built with React and Capacitor.

It offers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and an IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet) lookup to help with language learning and pronunciation. The app is cross-platform, currently targeting Web and Android.
